These terms and conditions will govern the use and access of the Justlife App and Website including any content, functionality, and services offered on or through www.Justlife.com. If you do not agree to accept and be bound by this Agreement, you must immediately stop using the website, app, or service.

Justlife will not be liable for any failure to perform its obligations hereunder where such failure results arising from any reason beyond Justlife's reasonable control, including, without limitation, electronic, mechanical, or communications failure or degradation.

Reproduction is strictly prohibited other than in accordance with the copyright notice, which forms part of these terms and conditions.

The users agree to hold Justlife free from the liability for any damages and/or missing items during or after using the cleaner/cleaning company partner services through Justlife.

  13. Justlife will charge you for your finalized bookings through the payment method specified on the website (credit card). If you happen to pay any applicable charges with your credit card, we may seek pre-authorization of your credit card account prior to your purchase.

  14. If you choose to pay the fee by your credit card, then you, as the cardholder, must retain a copy of transaction records and our policies and rules.

  15. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of all the information in your account.

  16. If you want to cancel your booking, you are required to give a minimum of 6 hours’ notice of cancellation. Any cancellations done from the time of the appointment up to 2 hours prior will be subject to 100% cancellation fee equal to the full value of the booking. We reserve the right to levy a charge of up to SAR 100 to cover any relevant administrative expenses.

  17. Customers using the website who are minors, i.e. under the age of 18 shall not register as a User of the website and shall not transact on or use the website.

  18. Justlife has the right to apply penalties to its cleaning service provider partners in the case of damage to the houses or house interiors in order to protect the community. However, what happens to the client's belongings and house interiors during the cleaning session is solely the client's responsibility. Justlife is not responsible for houses and interiors during the process of getting into the house or getting out of the house. Cleaners/cleaning company partners or Justlife are not obliged to cover any damage(s) caused during the cleaning session.

  19. If any provision of these Terms and Conditions is found to be unenforceable or/and invalid, that provision shall be limited to the minimum extent necessary so that the Terms and Conditions shall otherwise be kept in full force and effect. Justlife may transfer, assign or delegate the Terms and Conditions and its rights and obligations without consent.

  20. Justlife will not trade with or provide any services to OFAC and sanctioned countries.

  21. Justlife will send messages via Whatsapp, SMS, email, or notifications as means of communication for the purposes of including but not limited to appointment confirmation, appointment updates, and marketing.

  22. Justlife is your go-to booking platform exclusively focused on home cleaning services. Acting as an aggregator, we bring together a range of home cleaning options to meet your needs. Additionally, our network includes licensed third-party partners authorized by relevant authorities to ensure quality service.

Method of Payment, Card Types accepted and Currency

We accept payments online using Visa, MasterCard, and Amex credit/debit cards in SAR (or any other currency agreed).

 

Refund/Return policy

Refunds will be done only through the Original Mode of Payment.
